sentences.text: 4. Vide order dated 12.02.2024 the matter was referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Center of the Patna High Court to amicably resolve the dispute between the parties.

The learned Mediator has submitted its report dated 23.04.2024 in which it is clearly stated that the dispute between the parties has been resolved and the terms of settlement mutually agreed upon by them is being attached with this report.

5. In that view of the matter, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below where the case is pending/successor Court in connection with Complaint Case No.899 of 2019, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.
